{{Quote|The leadership of the tribe is a privilege to be earned<br />Before one is leader, three lessons must be learned<br />The lesson of the hand will teach both strength and speed<br />The lesson of the head is learned when hands do not succeed<br />But the lesson of the heart will make the leader strong<br />With head and heart together, the hand is never wrong|Chirpa, teaching lessons of leadership|<ref name="ttl">{{Ewoks|The Three Lessons}}</ref>}}
At the [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], the '''Three Lessons''' was a code of specific teachings that a heir of [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]] must learn before become the new [[Chief/Legends|chief]].

According [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]], the Three Lessons was:

*The '''Hand's Lesson''', to obtain strength and speed;
*The '''Head's Lesson''', that was learned when the hands fails;
*The '''Heart's Lesson''', the most important lesson for the most powerful leader. With the heart and the mind together, the hands never would fail.

[[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]] learned the Three Lessons, while was saving the [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|village]] during a [[stranglethorn]]'s attack. In doing so, her father noted that in doing so, she showed great potential as a Chieftainess.
